title: Strawberry Jam and Buttermilk Ice Cream (No Egg)
changes_from_base: Buttermilk replaces the milk for tang, and strawberry jam is rippled through in place of fresh puréed strawberries.
summary: Buttermilk gives this egg-free ice cream a gentle tang, like a frozen strawberry cheesecake, and thick ribbons of strawberry jam run through every scoop.

ingredients.item: light corn syrup or glucose syrup
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Sweeten the cream
steps.text: Heat the cream, sugar, syrup and salt in the saucepan, stirring, just until the sugar has dissolved. Pour into the jug and let it cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Add the buttermilk
steps.text: Whisk in the cold buttermilk and lemon juice only once the cream is cool; hot cream can make buttermilk split. Chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Loosen the jam
steps.text: Stir the jam in the small bowl until it is soft and spreadable, so it ribbons rather than sitting in lumps.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn the tangy base for 20-30 min, until thick.

steps.title: Swirl and freeze
steps.text: Spread a third of the ice cream in the container, dot with a third of the jam and repeat twice, then marble with a knife. Cover the surface and freeze for at least 4 h.

tips: Choose a jam with a high fruit content for the best flavour.
Let the cream cool fully before adding the buttermilk to avoid splitting.
Swap in raspberry or apricot jam for a change.
storage: Keep covered with baking paper pressed on the surface in the freezer for up to 2 weeks. Soften for 10 min in the fridge before scooping.
